networkIdentifiers.rule: Kept in the record exactly as the origin served it. Compared after mapping: a CAIP-2 identifier names itself, a v1 name maps through the table below, any other identifier is unknown and leaves the comparison unresolved.

note: Maps what binds an x402 evidence record to one payment, and what a chain read must show, to the record fields this suite checks. Two verdicts per case, each in the four states of the Evidence Chain RFP: verified, contradicted, indeterminate, not_evaluated.

authorization.contradicted: the record's binding disagrees with the authorization it carries
authorization.indeterminate: the record does not identify one authorization; the reason says why
authorization.verified: the record identifies one authorization by its full scope

settlement.contradicted: the chain read shows the authorization did not or cannot settle as the record binds it
settlement.indeterminate: settlement cannot be decided from this read; the reason separates a read that failed from a read that found nothing yet
settlement.not_evaluated: no chain read was made; an offline run records this, not a failure
settlement.verified: the chain read identifies the Transfer log that settled the authorization
